headline: Finance Committee to review budget amendments totaling over $1.6 million for city projects and health programs.
summary: The committee will consider resolutions amending the Community Improvement Program budget for several projects, including Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp Design and Construction, Hazmat Training, Community Health Workers CRU Funding, and Household Hazardous Waste Collection. It will also review related budget authorizations for these and other programs.
items: Resolution amending FY2023 CIP to authorize, appropriate, and transfer $1,630,167.75 for FY2023 CIP 711323 Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp Design and Construction
Resolution amending FY2027 CIP to authorize and appropriate $15,833 for FY2027 CIP C300040727 FY25 Hazmat Training
Resolution amending FY2022 and FY2027 CIP to authorize, appropriate, and transfer $10,000 for FY2027 CIP C410020327 Community Health Workers CRU Funding
Resolution amending FY2027 CIP to authorize and appropriate $20,445 for FY2027 CIP C500070527 FY27 Household Hazardous Waste Collection
Vote on whether the Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled
Budget Authorization review for 212322 ARPA - Community Health Worker Program
Budget Authorization review for 711323 Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp Design & Construction
Budget Authorization review for 712523 Bridge Inspection, Repair & Rehabilitation
Budget Authorization review for C300040727 FY25 Hazmat Training

plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON FINANCE 
October 20, 2026 Upon Recess of the BMA 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Mayor and All Aldermen 
 
AGENDA 
 
The Mayor calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Resolutions: (A motion is in order to read by titles only.) 
 
“Amending the FY2023 Community Improvement Program, authorizing, 
appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of One Million Six Hundred 
Thirty Thousand One Hundred Sixty-Seven Dollars and Seventy-Five Cents 
($1,630,167.75) for the FY2023 CIP 711323Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp 
Design and Construction.” 
 
“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and 
appropriating funds in the amount of Fifteen Thousand Eight Hundred Thirty-
Three Dollars ($15,833) for the FY2027 CIP C300040727 FY25 Hazmat 
Training.” 
 
“Amending the FY2022 and FY2027 Community Improvement Program, 
authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of Ten 
Thousand Dollars ($10,000) for the FY2027 CIP C410020327 Community 
Health Workers CRU Funding.” 
 
“Amending the FY2027 Community Improvement Program, authorizing and 
appropriating funds in the amount of Twenty Thousand Four Hundred Forty-
Five Dollars ($20,445) for the FY2027 CIP C500070527 FY27 Household 
Hazardous Waste Collection.” 
If the Committee so desires, a motion would be in order that the 
Resolutions ought to pass and be Enrolled.
October 20, 2026 COMMITTEE ON FINANCE 
Page 2 of 2 
 
2. Budget Authorizations: 
• 212322 ARPA - Community Health Worker Program 
• 711323 Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp Design & Construction 
• 712523 Bridge Inspection, Repair & Rehabilitation 
• C300040727 FY25 Hazmat Training 
• C410020327 Community Health Workers CRU Funding 
• C500070527 FY27 Household Hazardous Waste Collection 
If the Committee so desires, a motion would be in order that the Budget 
Authorizations be approved subject to final adoption of related 
Resolutions. 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
